title: The past tense
summary: Say what happened with the past tense `-DI` (*geldim*, *yaptık*), ask and deny with *geldin mi?* and *gelmedim*, keep the two sets of personal endings apart, and say when with *dün*, *geçen hafta* and *iki gün önce*.
canDo: Say what you did yesterday and at the weekend
Ask what someone did, and say what you didn't do
Say how long ago something happened, and that it hasn't happened yet
Say you're hungry, tired or late the Turkish way
